Definition: a lance (for thrusting, like pitching a tent)
BiblicalUsage: Chaniyth is the spear, the thrusting lance, and it is the weapon of the mighty men. There was no smith in Israel because the Philistines would not let the Hebrews make swords or spears. Jashobeam lifted up his spear against three hundred slain at one time, and the man who touches thorns must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the spear in these verses is less about the weapon than about who holds it. Israel had no smith and no spears until God gave them men who could lift one against three hundred. I hold that the weapon matters far less than the hand God puts it in.
